dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent and symmetrical reduction in 2D width from the upper boundary toward a sharp posterior termination point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; the lateral boundaries where the skin meets the dark water background are smooth and devoid of localized bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median light-grey pixel intensity with a perceptible blue-hue shift across the visible dorsal field.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse clusters of lower-intensity pixels (darker grey) distributed irregularly across the surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; boundaries between higher and lower intensity pixel regions exhibit a gradual, blurred gradient.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast, thin dark linear feature oriented longitudinally along the center of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible topological shadow-casting along a central longitudinal line, indicating a shallow physical depression or crease.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, distinct longitudinal mark or scar along the central dorsal ridge line.
